description: List supported watchlists (OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU, UK, UN, BIS Entity/Denied Persons/Unverified/Military End User, State ITAR Debarred/Nonproliferation) and GLEIF datasets with current mirrored counts, source URLs, licenses, readiness, and as-of timestamps. coverageNotice names unloaded CSL lists and how to refresh them; prior mirror readiness does not establish coverage of newly added lists. For GLEIF, reports Level 2 ownership relationships, reporting-exception coverage, and alternate-name index readiness. Use this for provenance, freshness, and coverage on any result. Attribution: UK data is under the Open Government Licence v3.0; BIS and State CSL data is supplied by the International Trade Administration under its published terms. This product uses the International Trade Administration’s Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the International Trade Administration.
name: sanctions_list_sources

alternateNamesIndexed.description: Whether the GLEIF alternate-name index — trading, previous, alternative-language, and transliterated names — is built. When false, sanctions_resolve_entity searches legal names only until mirror:init reloads the GLEIF golden copy. True on a GLEIF mirror that has never loaded (leiReady false): its empty index is complete, and the first load builds it with the entities.

coverageNotice.description: Unloaded CSL list codes and refresh guidance. Present when any CSL list has zero mirrored records; prior sanctions readiness does not establish coverage of newly added lists.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

leiAsOf.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed GLEIF sync, when available.

leiReady.description: True once the GLEIF (LEI) mirror has completed at least one full sync.

reportingExceptionsLoaded.description: Whether GLEIF reporting exceptions are loaded. When false, sanctions_trace_ownership reads a parent level with no published relationship as unknown.

sanctionsAsOf.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed sanctions sync, when available.

sanctionsReady.description: True once the sanctions mirror has completed at least one full sync.

sources.description: All supported sources, sanctions lists then the GLEIF dataset. Check coverageNotice for unloaded CSL lists.

items.description: One supported source with current mirrored count, provenance, and license; zero-record CSL lists are not loaded.

license.description: Redistribution license / terms for this source.

recordCount.description: Records currently loaded for this source — for gleif, Level 1 entity records.

relationshipCount.description: GLEIF Level 2 ownership relationships loaded (gleif only).

reportingExceptionCount.description: GLEIF reporting-exception records loaded (gleif only). Absent when the dataset has never been loaded — never read as zero.

url.description: Upstream URL the mirror harvests this source from, as configured — for gleif, the golden-copy API base.

title: sanctions-screening-mcp-server: list sources
